import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static List<Integer>[] adj = new ArrayList[2020];
    static int[][] ir = new int[20][20], sc = new int[20][20], pc = new int[20][20];
    static char[][] s = new char[20][20], p = new char[20][20];
    static int[][] dd = new int[20][20];
    static int[] dx = {0, 1, -1, 0};
    static int[] dy = {1, 0, 0, -1};
    static List<Integer>[][] ns = new ArrayList[20][20], np = new ArrayList[20][20];

    static int[] dist = new int[2020], parent = new int[2020];
    static int sp, pp;
    static int n, t;

    static {
        for (int i = 0; i < 2020; i++) {
            adj[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < 20; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < 20; j++) {
                ns[i][j] = new ArrayList<>();
                np[i][j] = new ArrayList<>();
            }
        }
    }

    static void addEdge(int a, int b) {
        adj[a].add(b);
        adj[b].add(a);
    }

    static boolean bfs() {
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        for (int i = 1; i <= sp; i++) {
            if (parent[i] == 0) {
                dist[i] = 0;
                q.offer(i);
            } else {
                dist[i] = 3010;
            }
        }
        dist[0] = 3010;
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int u = q.poll();
            if (dist[u] < dist[0]) {
                for (int v : adj[u]) {
                    int v_idx = parent[v];
                    if (dist[v_idx] > dist[u] + 1) {
                        dist[v_idx] = dist[u] + 1;
                        q.offer(v_idx);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return dist[0] != 3010;
    }

    static boolean dfs(int x) {
        if (x == 0) return true;
        for (int u : adj[x]) {
            int v = parent[u];
            if (dist[v] == dist[x] + 1) {
                if (dfs(v)) {
                    parent[x] = u;
                    parent[u] = x;
                    return true;
                }
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    static int maxMatch() {
        int matchCount = 0;
        while (bfs()) {
            for (int i = 1; i <= sp; i++) {
                if (parent[i] == 0)
                    matchCount += dfs(i) ? 1 : 0;
            }
        }
        return matchCount;
    }

    static void process(int a, int b) {
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                dd[i][j] = 100000;
            }
        }
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        dd[a][b] = 0;
        q.offer(new int[]{a, b});
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] xy = q.poll();
            int x = xy[0], y = xy[1];
            for (int i = 0; i < np[x][y].size(); i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < ns[a][b].size(); j++) {
                    addEdge(ns[a][b].get(j), np[x][y].get(i));
                }
            }
            if (dd[x][y] == ir[x][y]) continue;
            for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
                int nx = x + dx[d], ny = y + dy[d];
                if (sc[nx][ny] != -1 && dd[nx][ny] > dd[x][y] + 1 && dd[x][y] + 1 <= ir[nx][ny]) {
                    dd[nx][ny] = dd[x][y] + 1;
                    q.offer(new int[]{nx, ny});
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scn = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = scn.nextInt();
        t = scn.nextInt();

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(ir[i], 0);
            Arrays.fill(sc[i], 0);
            Arrays.fill(pc[i], 0);
            s[i] = new char[n + 1];
            p[i] = new char[n + 1];
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            String row = scn.next();
            s[i] = (" " + row).toCharArray();
        }
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            String row = scn.next();
            p[i] = (" " + row).toCharArray();
        }

        int rx = 1, ry = 1;
        sp = 1;
        pp = 1000;

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                if (s[i][j] == 'Z' || s[i][j] == 'Y') {
                    sc[i][j] = -1;
                    ir[i][j] = 0;
                }
                if (s[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    rx = i;
                    ry = j;
                    ir[i][j] = 0;
                }
                if ('0' <= s[i][j] && s[i][j] <= '9') {
                    sc[i][j] = s[i][j] - '0';
                }
                for (int k = 0; k < sc[i][j]; k++) {
                    ns[i][j].add(sp++);
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                if ('0' <= p[i][j] && p[i][j] <= '9') {
                    pc[i][j] = p[i][j] - '0';
                }
                for (int k = 0; k < pc[i][j]; k++) {
                    np[i][j].add(pp++);
                }
            }
        }

        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.offer(new int[]{rx, ry});
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] xy = q.poll();
            int x = xy[0], y = xy[1];
            for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
                int nx = x + dx[d], ny = y + dy[d];
                if (ir[nx][ny] > ir[x][y] + 1 && sc[nx][ny] != -1) {
                    ir[nx][ny] = ir[x][y] + 1;
                    q.offer(new int[]{nx, ny});
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                if (sc[i][j] > 0) {
                    process(i, j);
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(maxMatch());
    }
}
